title: Jiff 1.0 Released as a Rust Datetime Library
summary: Jiff 1.0, a datetime library for Rust, has been released for Rust developers who need date, time, and time-zone handling. The 1.0 milestone is being discussed as an alternative to the existing chrono crate; the supplied item does not include API details, migration notes, or benchmarks.
